description: Defines the CaptureSequencer class responsible for managing still image capture processes in Android's camera framework, including handling capture states, notifications, and interactions with other camera components.

classes.name: CaptureSequencer
classes.description: Manages the still image capture process, including state management, notifications, and interactions with camera hardware and processing components.

methods.name: setZslProcessor
methods.description: Sets the ZslProcessor which manages ZSL buffers and frames.

methods.name: waitUntilIdle
methods.description: Blocks until the current capture completes or times out.

methods.name: notifyShutter
methods.description: Notifies the start of a capture shutter event.

methods.name: onResultAvailable
methods.description: Handles available capture results from the frame processor.

methods.name: threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop for capture thread execution.

methods.name: shutterNotifyLocked
methods.description: Sends shutter notification and plays sound.
